turn_taking.fact: Cut-ins by config: A 25%, B 15%, C 33%, E 50% of 60 turns; 0/30 on turns without an internal pause >= 0.5 s; mid-turn 0.9-1.3 s pauses A 72%, E 100%; elderly 2.4 s pause 12/12 every config
Quiet elderly 'hmm' (0.45 s) never transcribed in any cascade or Voice Live arm: agent stays silent
Competitor demos: collisions Vapi 35%, Ultravox 18%, ElevenLabs 3%; barge-in handled Ultravox 6/6, ElevenLabs 3/7, Vapi 2/8; ElevenLabs answered haan/hmm with 'are you still there' 4/16
Taxila Voice Live ref-AEC front end: 0/66 echo false barge-in, 12/12 true barge-in, end-of-turn p50 1,480 ms vs 900 ms bar, empty transcripts on 5/14 short answers
Competitor defaults: Vapi 1.5 s end-of-turn wait; Retell 0 ms added wait, interruption 0.9; Bolna 500 + 900 ms; ElevenLabs eagerness Normal, Turn V3; 0 of 6 ship Hindi/Hinglish backchannel lists

conversation_quality.fact: Round-1 robotic signature: 53% turns end on a question, median 22 words (p90 37), 21% restate AI, 19% mention link/callback/advisor
